CalculationStatus.description:
Machine-readable outcome of a calculation attempt.

Pure calculators (Slice B) may return:

- ``OK`` — required inputs resolved and calculation completed.
- ``NOT_APPLICABLE`` — inputs are valid but the selected method is
  inapplicable (e.g. non-positive EPS or BVPS for the Graham Number).
- ``INVALID_INPUT`` — supplied value, unit, basis, or method/flag
  combination is invalid.

Resolver/provider layers (Slice C and later) will additionally return:

- ``INPUT_UNAVAILABLE`` — a required input could not be resolved under
  the requested time boundary.
- ``PROVIDER_ERROR`` — the configured provider failed in a way that
  should be distinguished from an absent fact.

FailureEnvelope.description:

A command with ``--json`` writes it to standard output when it fails, and it is the body of every non-2xx API
response.

and is independent of the ``schema_version`` of every success document. A consumer dispatches on
``status`` and ``result`` first, then on ``analysis``. ``reason_code`` is stable; ``reason`` and
``diagnostics[].reason`` are messages for people and carry no guarantee.

One event of a refresh job: a job of the refresh started, or finished.

``sequence`` counts the job's events from 1 in the order they were recorded. ``position`` is the entry's 0-based
place in the refresh, the same as a saved run's ``batch_position`` and the index of an ``entries[i]`` error; it is

``state`` is an open vocabulary: ``running``, ``stopping``, ``completed``, ``stopped`` and ``failed``. ``summary``
is set for ``completed`` and ``stopped``, ``failure`` for ``failed``; the events already recorded are kept in
either case.

RefreshResultDocument.description:
One (ticker, selection) job of a refresh.

Exactly one of a saved run (``analysis_run_id``), an unsaved outcome (``status`` with no run) and a failure
(``error``) describes the job, and ``reason_code`` is set if and only if the job raised (``error``) or its
``status`` is ``failed``. An ``unavailable`` job is an analysis outcome and carries none.

analysis_run_id.description: The saved run; null when nothing was saved.
analysis_run_id.title: Analysis Run Id

error.description: The message the application wrote for the failure, chosen by its code; null unless the job raised.
error.title: Error

reason_code.description: The stable code of the failure; null unless the job raised or its status is failed.

status.description: The run's or the unsaved outcome's status; null for a raised job.

RefreshResultDocument.title: RefreshResultDocument

RefreshSummaryDocument.description:
The one document ``refresh --json`` writes when the refresh completes.

``schema_version`` is this document's own lineage and is independent of every other document's.

counts.description: Jobs per status; a job that raised counts as 'error'.

provider_check.description: What one test request found for each provider a failed job implicates, one entry per provider; null when no job failed on a provider.
provider_check.title: Provider Check

watchlist_id.description: The watchlist refreshed; null for a refresh of a list of entries.
watchlist_id.title: Watchlist Id

watchlist_name.description: The watchlist's name when it was refreshed; null exactly when watchlist_id is.
watchlist_name.title: Watchlist Name

WatchlistDeleteDocument.description:
The outcome of ``watchlist delete --json``, with the watchlist it removed when there was one.

``deleted`` is false, and ``watchlist`` and ``unreadable`` both null, only for ``--missing-ok`` on a name that does
not exist. Otherwise exactly one of ``watchlist`` and ``unreadable`` is set.

unreadable.description: The first entry this version could not read; null when nothing was deleted.

watchlist.description: The deleted watchlist; null when an entry was unreadable or nothing was deleted.

WatchlistDeleteDocument.title: WatchlistDeleteDocument

WatchlistDocument.description:
The complete watchlist, as every command that writes one with ``--json`` prints it.

These are ``watchlist show``, ``create`` and ``add-selection``; the API serves it for a watchlist, for a created
watchlist and for an added entry, and the result documents below nest it.
